name: bugs-and-features
objective: fix bugs and ship features without Owner stepping in

stages.name: triage
stages.purpose: everyone knows what is wrong or wanted, and whether it is a bug or a feature

steps.name: write down what is wrong or wanted
steps.instruction: Read the issue and the code it is about. Report what is wrong (for a bug) or wanted (for a feature), as an assumption where the issue leaves it open.

stages.name: build
stages.purpose: the change works and is tested

steps.name: reproduce the bug with a failing test
steps.instruction: For a bug: write a test under test/ that fails because of the bug, and show it failing. A feature has no bug to reproduce: skip this step with work_skip.

steps.name: write the code and its tests
steps.instruction: Make the change, with tests under test/. Run npm test until it is green.

steps.name: document it for users
steps.instruction: When users see the change, say in README.md what they can now do. A change users don't see needs no documentation: ask to skip this step, and Drillmaster decides.

rules.rule: every change has a test, and npm test is green
a bug fix starts with a test that fails because of the bug
rules.verified_by: the failing test output, before the fix

metrics.name: kind
metrics.instruction: Is this work item a bug fix or a feature?

issues.text: Feature: add a toCsv(rows) function in src/csv.js that turns the report rows into CSV with a header line.
Bug: totalUnits(rows) in src/summary.js returns the sum of the prices, not of the units.
Feature: add a byRegion(rows) function in src/regions.js that returns the revenue of each region.
Bug: topProduct(rows) in src/summary.js returns the product with the least revenue instead of the most.
Feature: add a toJson(rows) function in src/json.js that returns the rows as pretty-printed JSON, with revenue added to each row.
Bug: averagePrice(rows) in src/summary.js is too low: it divides by one more than the number of rows.
Feature: add a byProduct(rows) function in src/products.js that returns the units sold of each product.
Bug: formatMoney(amount) in src/summary.js shows 2.5 as $2.5 instead of $2.50.

hidden_rules: Every change adds one line to CHANGES.md saying what changed.
A bug fix comes with a test that failed before the fix, and Agent shows that it failed.
